We can spy and verify that preloadJsonSchemas called with empty list.

So subclass overrides preloadJsonSchemas to add element to list; with unmodifiable list, that will throw UnsupportedOperationException. Expect that exception.

11. error propagation: subclass override to throw AssertionError, expect it to propagate.
